name: dock-badges
title: Dock Badges
description: Notification badge counts from your Dock, in the menu bar — for people who hide their Dock.
author: mrpunkin

commands.name: show-dock-badges
commands.title: Show Dock Badges
commands.subtitle: Dock Badges
commands.description: Menu bar item showing the summed notification badge count of every app in your Dock.

preferences.name: symbol
preferences.title: Icon
preferences.description: Symbol shown in the menu bar. It turns red whenever a Dock app has notifications; Bell and App also gain a badge.

preferences.name: symbolStyle
preferences.title: Icon Style
preferences.description: Filled or outline rendering of the menu bar symbol.

preferences.name: showCount
preferences.title: Count
preferences.label: Show Total Count
preferences.description: Show the summed badge count next to the menu bar icon. When disabled, only the badge on the icon indicates notifications.

preferences.name: hideWhenClear
preferences.label: Hide When Clear
preferences.description: Remove the menu bar item entirely while no Dock app has a badge.
preferences.title: Visibility

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
